decision: Individually exclude POD-EDIT-095 as Census data/navigation utility. Preserve the Anugul public route, district 384 data, Census group/return and residence caveats, language-profile links and search eligibility. This route has no configured destination or related-discovery narrative and no sustained authored district-language article.
